Context: 10. T.A. on Transfer

While the grade of the Government servant is determined with reference to the facts on the date of his transfer, the number of fares admissible is to be determined with reference to the facts on the date of journey. No travelling allowance is admissible for any member added to the family after the date of transfer. - SR 116 (b) (iii).
